title: Comparison of refractive predictability and endothelial cell loss in femtosecond laser-assisted cataract surgery and conventional phaco surgery: prospective randomised trial with 6 months of follow-up

license.statement: CC BY-NC 4.0 (article <license> and ali:license_ref https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc/4.0/); not CC BY or CC0, so the record is private

indication: Bilateral visually significant cataract of any type and degree; severe dry eye, corneal scars, herpetic keratitis, keratoconus, uveitis, pseudoexfoliation, uncontrolled glaucoma, maculopathy, vitreomacular traction and previous ocular surgery excluded

groups.description: Femtosecond laser-assisted cataract surgery (LensAR: 5.0 mm capsulotomy and lens fragmentation) followed by conventional phaco steps (divide and conquer, Infiniti) and aspheric hydrophobic IOL; one eye per patient by computer block randomisation; single surgeon
Conventional phaco surgery (manual capsulorhexis, divide and conquer, Infiniti, same IOL) in the contralateral eye of the same patients

series.baseline_label: Mean preoperative ECD (Table 5) = preoperative central ECD of the operated eye
series.notes: Table 5 'FLACS (95% CI)' column, rows 'Mean preoperative ECD', 'Mean 40 days ECD' and 'Mean 180 days ECD' (mean with 95% CI); day 40 = 40/30.4375 and day 180 = 180/30.4375 months; per-visit n from the Table 5 title row (preoperatively, day 40, day 180). Topcon SP-3000P non-contact specular microscopy with ImageNet, manually corrected counts.

series.baseline_label: Mean preoperative ECD (Table 5) = preoperative central ECD of the operated eye
series.notes: Table 5 'CPS (95% CI)' column, rows 'Mean preoperative ECD', 'Mean 40 days ECD' and 'Mean 180 days ECD' (mean with 95% CI); day 40 = 40/30.4375 and day 180 = 180/30.4375 months; per-visit n from the Table 5 title row.

exclusions.what: Table 5 'Mean 40 days ECL' and 'Mean 180 days ECL' rows (cells/mm2 and %)
exclusions.reason: The same table gives absolute ECD for each group; the absolute ECD series is used

exclusions.what: Table 5 hexagonality rows and P value column; Table 6 regression
exclusions.reason: Not endothelial cell density; p-values and model estimates are not admissible

notes: Role: two established cataract techniques randomised against each other without an investigational agent (femtosecond-assisted surgery is listed under the protocol's cataract context); both control-role, separate groups.

Paired-eye design: each patient had FLACS in one randomly allocated eye and CPS in the contralateral eye; the CPS eyes are operated comparison eyes, not unoperated fellow eyes. The two series share patients.
Visits are labelled day 40 and day 180; the reported mean (SD) intervals from operation were 60 (34) and 234 (124) days. Table labels are used for the months.
Of 108 enrolled patients, those not operated on both eyes were excluded (96 analysed for surgery data).
